units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 33b:3">B. Mets. 33ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 58:1">Is. LVIII, 1</cite>) <he>חַטֹּאתָם אלו וכ׳</he> ‘their mistakes’, this refers to the ignorant whose wilful sins are accounted to them as errors.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:10">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 14:34">Prov. XIV, 34</cite>) <he>וחסד לישראל ולאמים ח׳</he> (differ. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) but benevolence is a sin-offering for Israel as well as for gentiles.
<cite ref="Proverbs 14:34">Ib.</cite> <he>כשם שהח׳ מכפרת וכ׳</he> (differ. in Ms. M.) as well as the sin-offering brings atonement to Israel &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:1">Zeb. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חַטָּאוֹת</he>; constr. <he>חַטְּאוֹת</he>, <cite ref="H00587"><he>חַטֹּאת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Ib. V, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ הצבור</he> congregational sin-offerings.
<cite ref="Zevachim 112a:13">Ib. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>הפריש שתי ח׳ וכ׳</he> if he sets apart two sin-offerings for security’s sake; a. v. fr.
